preconditions.description: The number of words in the text is between 1 and 300 inclusive.
Each word consists of at least one lowercase Latin letter.
The total length of the text (letters + spaces) does not exceed 100,000.
The input text is exactly the space-separated concatenation of the words.

postconditions.expression: result == len(original_text) if no_abbreviation_possible else min(len(original_text), min(len(abbreviated_text) for abbreviated_text in possible_abbreviations))
postconditions.description: The result is the minimum length of the text after at most one abbreviation, where an abbreviation replaces at least two non-intersecting equal segments with their uppercase first letters.

postconditions.expression: all(abbreviated_text == apply_abbreviation(original_text, segment1, segment2) for abbreviated_text in possible_abbreviations for segment1 in segments for segment2 in segments if segments_equal(segment1, segment2) and not segments_overlap(segment1, segment2))
postconditions.description: Each possible abbreviation is derived by replacing two non-intersecting equal segments with their uppercase first letters.
The result length is at least the original length minus the maximum possible abbreviation savings (replacing two segments of length `max_segment_length` with `max_segment_length` uppercase letters).
